# EMET — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 19
**Agent:** EMET (Literal/Transparent)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 18-19 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 19

---

**19:1** When Levi had said this, they began to go forth to proclaim and preach.

---

**The Gospel according to Mary.**

---

*Translator's Note (EMET):* Chapter 19 is the gospel's closing verse, identical in content to the shorter chapter 15 (in other editorial schemas). The gospel ends as it began the mission section — with action. The Coptic manuscript closes with the title inscription. There is no epilogue, no return to Mary, no resolution of the Peter-Mary conflict recorded. The departure for mission is the text's only answer to the dispute it raises.

*Manuscript note:* P.Berol. 8502 ends here. The colophon "The Gospel according to Mary" (Coptic: *peuaggelion kata Maria*) is written in the manuscript in a slightly larger hand, as is typical for Nag Hammadi colophons.
